line: I feel my lotus bloom, come closer
vault_lines: I feel my lotus bloom, come closer
meaning:
The lotus flower (or padma) is associated with Indian religion, but the word itself rolls off the tongue quite nicely.

In addition, in Greek Mythology, the lotus-eaters were a race of people that lured people to their island, and used lotus flowers to make them stay forever.

The Lotus flower is also a symbol of femininity and fertility, and is also used to represent the womanhood area. When the flower is in bloom, it opens up and blossoms. Katy could be using this to denote her womanhood ‘blossoming’. The previous verse paints a romantic scene “under a silver moon, tropical temperature” adding to her arousal, thus prompting her womanhood to ‘bloom’ and with her sexual sensations awakened, she urges her lover to ‘come closer.’
